name: io.github.mguttmann/the-real-snipeit-mcp
title: Snipe-IT (unofficial)
description: Unofficial MCP server for the Snipe-IT REST API: assets, users, licenses, guarded writes.

environmentVariables.name: SNIPEIT_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Snipe-IT API base URL including /api/v1, for example https://snipe-it.example.com/api/v1. Use https.

environmentVariables.name: SNIPEIT_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Snipe-IT Personal API Token (JWT), from Snipe-IT > User > Manage API Keys. It acts with the rights of its user.

environmentVariables.name: SNIPEIT_CONFIRM_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Write guard, on by default: write tools return a preview until called again with confirm: "YES". Only false, 0, no or off disable it.

environmentVariables.name: SNIPEIT_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Timeout in ms per HTTP attempt, including the body read (positive integer).

environmentVariables.name: SNIPEIT_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log level on stderr: debug, info, warn or error.

environmentVariables.name: SNIPEIT_MAX_RESULT_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Cap for one tool result in bytes (serialized JSON), minimum 65536. Larger results come back shortened with truncated: true.

environmentVariables.name: SNIPEIT_CALL_DEADLINE_MS
environmentVariables.description: Overall deadline for one tool call in ms, across retries and all: true pagination. 0 means none.

environmentVariables.name: SNIPEIT_REDACT_PII
environmentVariables.description: true masks personal data (email, username, names of people, phone, address, employee number) in tool results.

environmentVariables.name: SNIPEIT_REDACT_SECRETS
environmentVariables.description: true masks secrets (password/secret/token/api_key fields, secret custom field values) in tool results with (redacted).

environmentVariables.name: SNIPEIT_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: true refuses every write at runtime; all tools stay registered and reads work.

environmentVariables.name: SNIPEIT_REQUIRE_PREVIEW
environmentVariables.description: true (with the write guard on): confirm: "YES" executes only after a preview of the same request.
